request.description: Matches the Call History tab with exact table columns: date, time, name, property_address, lead_type, formatted_trust_gain, outcome, formatted_ai_adherence, duration_formatted, has_report, and summary counts.
Matches the Follow up Queue tab with calculated followup_due_text (e.g. Follow up in 1 day, Overdue by 2 days).
Quickly change outcome from the dropdown badge (e.g., Appointment Set, Follow Up, Not A Fit). Automatically syncs with leads table.
Explicitly add or remove a call from the follow-up queue.
